definitions.gloss: food and drink; food and beverages
definitions.explanation: A collective noun for things to eat and drink. Common on signs and in formal contexts; in casual speech, {食|た}べ{物|もの}と{飲|の}み{物|もの} is more typical.

examples.japanese: ⟦{館内|かんない}→館内：22088_kannai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飲食物|いんしょくぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}み→持ち込み：08293_mochikomi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧です。
examples.english: Bringing food and drink into the hall is prohibited.

examples.japanese: {飲食物|いんしょくぶつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{各自|かくじ}→各自：00157_kakuji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{用意|ようい}して→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please prepare your own food and drink.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{飲食物|いんしょくぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{行|おこな}っている→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{手|て}ぶら→手ぶら：12755_tebura⟧で⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}→大丈夫：00772_daijoubu⟧です。
examples.english: The venue also sells food and drink, so it's fine to come empty-handed.

notes:
Composed of {飲|いん} (drink) + {食|しょく} (eat) + ⟦{物|ぶつ}→〜物：28336_butsu⟧ (things). A formal collective noun, very common on signage, in rules, and in business writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飲食物|いんしょくぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}み→持ち込み：08293_mochikomi⟧: bringing in food and drink
- {飲食物|いんしょくぶつ}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: no food or drink
- {飲食物|いんしょくぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧: sale of food and beverages
- {飲食物|いんしょくぶつ}⟦{以外|いがい}→以外：01297_igai⟧: items other than food and drink

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{飲|の}み{物|もの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧: food and drinks — everyday phrasing
- ⟦{飲食|いんしょく}→飲食：03010_inshoku⟧: eating and drinking — the act, not the items
- ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧: food products — narrower; refers to food alone, often packaged
